next.reason: 1985: "If the CODE-SET clause is specified for a file, all data in that file must be described as USAGE IS DISPLAY"; 2023: "If there are record description entries associated with the file and no SELECT WHEN clauses are specified ... usage national". The 2023 display rule holds only when record entries exist and there is no SELECT WHEN; with alphabet-name-2 it requires usage national. 1985 required DISPLAY for all data, unconditionally.
